disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

The /sidebar/api/fs.read route provided by the plugin can theoretically accept arbitrary absolute paths to read files (including credential files), but it requires passing the browser trust fence and is not an operation initiated by the plugin itself; this has been noted in the inspection item.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 cordis.patch.yml 中的 !!js 表达式（规则 DSH-P01/DG-R3-51）：表达式为聚合双挂载守卫（ctx.loader.entries().some(...)），判断其他已启用实例是否存在以禁用自身，属只读谓词、无副作用，为良性机制。
checked_items.en: Checked the !!js expressions in cordis.patch.yml (rules DSH-P01/DG-R3-51): the expression is an aggregated dual-mount guard (ctx.loader.entries().some(...)) that judges whether other enabled instances exist to disable itself; it is a read-only predicate, has no side effects, and is a benign mechanism.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package.json 的 prepare 脚本（规则 DSH-X02/DG-R3-54）：执行 tsdown 本地构建，将 src/ 目录编译为 lib/ 产物，无远程下载、无凭据访问、无网络行为，属标准工程实践。
checked_items.en: Checked the prepare script in package.json (rules DSH-X02/DG-R3-54): it runs a tsdown local build, compiling the src/ directory into lib/ artifacts; no remote download, no credential access, no network behavior; it is a standard engineering practice.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 child_process 使用（规则 DSH-X03/DG-R3-55）：src/git.ts 通过 spawn('git', args) 执行系统 git，参数为数组形式（无 shell:true）、无命令注入风险；tests/ 中的 new Function 和 spawnSync 为测试桩，不在生产运行。
checked_items.en: Checked child_process usage (rules DSH-X03/DG-R3-55): src/git.ts executes system git via spawn('git', args) with arguments in array form (no shell:true); no command-injection risk. The new Function and spawnSync in tests/ are test stubs and do not run in production.

checked_items.zh: 检查了键盘事件监听（规则 DSH-X05/DG-R3-57）：ime-guard.ts 的 document 级键盘监听为 IME 输入法合成守卫（阻止 composition 期间的事件传播），mermaid.tsx 和 UploadOverlay.tsx 的 window 级监听为 Esc 关闭弹窗，tests/ime-guard.spec.ts 为单元测试——均为良性 UI 功能，无输入捕获或外泄行为。
checked_items.en: Checked keyboard event listeners (rules DSH-X05/DG-R3-57): the document-level keyboard listener in ime-guard.ts is an IME composition guard (preventing event propagation during composition); the window-level listeners in mermaid.tsx and UploadOverlay.tsx are for Esc to close modals; tests/ime-guard.spec.ts is a unit test — all are benign UI functionality with no input capture or exfiltration behavior.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 CI/CD 工作流（规则 DSH-X07/DG-R3-59）：.github/workflows/ci.yml 为常规测试+挂载冒烟，.github/workflows/release.yml 为 npm 发布（OIDC Trusted Publishing），无凭据外泄或恶意行为。
checked_items.en: Checked CI/CD workflows (rules DSH-X07/DG-R3-59): .github/workflows/ci.yml is routine testing plus mount smoke test; .github/workflows/release.yml is npm publishing (OIDC Trusted Publishing); no credential exfiltration or malicious behavior.

checked_items.zh: 检查了动态代码执行路径（eval、new Function 等），生产代码中无 eval（仅测试中 new Function 用于测试 chunk 加载）。
checked_items.en: Checked dynamic code execution paths (eval, new Function, etc.); production code contains no eval (only in tests is new Function used for testing chunk loading).

checked_items.zh: 检查了 client 侧 bundle 加载机制（src/client/chunk-loader.ts、src/bundle-route.ts）：chunk 脚本通过同源 /sidebar/bundle 路由加载，附 ETag 缓存校验，无远程代码注入。
checked_items.en: Checked the client-side bundle loading mechanism (src/client/chunk-loader.ts, src/bundle-route.ts): chunk scripts are loaded via the same-origin /sidebar/bundle route with ETag cache validation; no remote code injection.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 node-pty 终端创建（src/agent-pty.ts、src/pty-manager.ts）：shell 通过 node-pty.spawn() 创建，参数由配置和插件代码控制，无命令注入。
checked_items.en: Checked node-pty terminal creation (src/agent-pty.ts, src/pty-manager.ts): the shell is created via node-pty.spawn(); arguments are controlled by configuration and plugin code; no command injection.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 含 !!js 表达式（DG-R3-51），但表达式为只读守卫（禁用自身当其他实例已挂载），非恶意载荷，无副作用。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains a !!js expression (DG-R3-51), but the expression is a read-only guard (disables itself when other instances are already mounted); it is not a malicious payload and has no side effects.

evidence.zh: 未发现 cordis_define/cordis_run 动态包工具调用。插件通过标准 ctx.tools.register 注册终端工具，工具在 node:vm 外的宿主进程执行。
evidence.en: No dynamic package tool invocations via cordis_define/cordis_run were found. The plugin registers terminal tools via standard ctx.tools.register; tools execute in the host process outside node:vm.

evidence.zh: prepare 脚本（tsdown）为本地构建，无远程下载；scripts/install.sh 和 scripts/install.ps1 为可选用户安装脚本，非 npm 生命周期钩子；树内执行载体（workflows、Makefile 等）为常规 CI/CD。
evidence.en: The prepare script (tsdown) is a local build with no remote download; scripts/install.sh and scripts/install.ps1 are optional user install scripts, not npm lifecycle hooks; in-tree execution carriers (workflows, Makefile, etc.) are routine CI/CD.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了 dsh.client，client bundle 通过 /sidebar/bundle 路由加载同源 chunk，有 ETag 缓存校验，无键盘监听外泄或剪贴板滥用（键盘监听为 IME 守卫和 UI 快捷键）。
evidence.en: The plugin declares dsh.client; the client bundle loads same-origin chunks via the /sidebar/bundle route with ETag cache validation; no keyboard-listener exfiltration or clipboard abuse (keyboard listeners are IME guards and UI shortcuts).

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部 curl 使用（规则 DSH-C05/DG-R4-53）：scripts/e2e-aggregate-mount.sh 中的 curl 全部指向本地测试服务器（127.0.0.1），用于端到端冒烟测试断言，非产品运行时行为。
checked_items.en: Checked all curl usage (rule DSH-C05/DG-R4-53): all curl calls in scripts/e2e-aggregate-mount.sh point to the local test server (127.0.0.1), used for end-to-end smoke test assertions; not product runtime behavior.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有出站网络请求：src/index.ts 的 browser.probe 路由接收用户提供的 URL 做 HEAD/GET 探测（仅返回响应头、状态码），限制非回环地址、8 秒超时，为侧边栏浏览器的内嵌检测功能；其余网络请求均为同源（/sidebar/api、/sidebar/upload、/sidebar/ws/*、/sidebar/bundle）。
checked_items.en: Checked all outbound network requests: the browser.probe route in src/index.ts accepts user-provided URLs and performs HEAD/GET probes (returning only response headers and status codes), restricted to non-loopback addresses with an 8-second timeout; it is the embedded detection feature of the sidebar browser. All other network requests are same-origin (/sidebar/api, /sidebar/upload, /sidebar/ws/*, /sidebar/bundle).

checked_items.zh: 检查了 client 侧 fetch 调用（src/client/api.ts）：所有 API 调用指向 /sidebar/api 同源路径，无外部域名连接。
checked_items.en: Checked client-side fetch calls (src/client/api.ts): all API calls target the same-origin /sidebar/api path; no external domain connections.

checked_items.zh: 检查了编码外发链、DNS 隧道、端点劫持等模式，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked encoding exfiltration chains, DNS tunneling, endpoint hijacking, and other patterns; none were found.

evidence.zh: 插件未读取凭据文件后外发；curl 仅在 e2e 测试脚本中出现，指向本地测试服务器；browser.probe 的 fetch 为功能特性，仅返回响应头，不发送凭据。
evidence.en: The plugin does not read credential files and then exfiltrate them; curl only appears in e2e test scripts pointing to the local test server; the fetch in browser.probe is a functional feature that returns only response headers and does not send credentials.

checked_items.en: Checked dependency declarations: all @deepseek-ai/* dependencies in package.json are peerDependencies (version range ^0.1.0-rc.8); no typosquatting suspicion.

checked_items.en: Checked git dependency locking: the plugin is published as an npm package, not a git dependency.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 patch 覆盖安全行（DSH-P03/P04/P05）：cordis.patch.yml 未触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 配置行，未禁用安全插件，未改写 inject/intercept 配置。

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件注册的 WebSocket 和 HTTP 路由：所有路由（/sidebar/api、/sidebar/upload、/sidebar/file、/sidebar/html、/sidebar/bundle、/sidebar/ws/terminal、/sidebar/ws/agent-terminals）均通过浏览器信任围栏（isTrustedApiRequest）保护，该围栏检查 Host 头回环/可信地址 + 同源标记，防跨站请求。围栏官方描述为可达性策略、非认证层（DSH 生态固有风险）。
checked_items.en: Checked the WebSocket and HTTP routes registered by the plugin: all routes (/sidebar/api, /sidebar/upload, /sidebar/file, /sidebar/html, /sidebar/bundle, /sidebar/ws/terminal, /sidebar/ws/agent-terminals) are protected by the browser trust fence (isTrustedApiRequest), which checks the Host header loopback/trusted address plus same-origin markers to prevent cross-site requests. The fence is officially described as a reachability policy, not an authentication layer (an inherent risk of the DSH ecosystem).

checked_items.zh: 检查了 /sidebar/api 的 fs.read/fs.write 路由接受任意绝对路径（无会话工作区限定），与媒体/html/上传路由形成对比（后三者校验 isWithin）。该设计为 git 操作需要解析仓库根之上路径所必需，属刻意设计，已在 AGENTS.md 中记录。
checked_items.en: Checked that the fs.read/fs.write routes under /sidebar/api accept arbitrary absolute paths (not limited to the session workspace), in contrast to the media/html/upload routes (the latter three validate isWithin). This design is necessary for git operations to resolve paths above the repository root; it is deliberate and documented in AGENTS.md.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（L4 未启用）。

evidence.zh: 插件通过 DSH 宿主 webserver 注册路由，使用宿主提供的浏览器信任围栏作为保护层，未自行启动独立 web 服务或监听端口。围栏为可达性策略、非认证层为 DSH 生态固有风险。
evidence.en: The plugin registers routes through the DSH host web server, using the host-provided browser trust fence as a protection layer, and does not start its own standalone web service or listen on ports. The fence being a reachability policy rather than an authentication layer is an inherent risk of the DSH ecosystem.
